title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead
abstract: arXiv:2608.13987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nanbeige4.2-3B is a 3B-parameter agentic model built around a Looped Transformer (LT) that reuses one stack of layers for a second forward pass, adding effective depth without additional parameters. Evaluated on Apple Silicon (MPS), we identify five independent bugs which prevent the released checkpoint from running via Hugging Face transformers out of the box (including a silently-zeroed RoPE buffer and calls to removed transformers cache APIs). Furthermore, we show that fixing these bugs is still not sufficient for agentic tasks, due to the LT's layer-reuse strategy (which effectively doubles peak attention memory) used to achieve parameter efficiency. We thus introduce a chunked-prefill strategy which alleviates the incurred memory-capacity penalty, extending allowable context width by $2.7 \times$ on 32~GiB shared memory. However, even with the reduced memory overhead, we show that patches are required to render Nanbeige4.2-3B usable

translated_title: Nanbeige4.2-3B在苹果硅芯片上的运行：修复部署错误并降低循环变换器内存开销
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13987v1 公告类型：新公告。摘要：Nanbeige4.2-3B是一个基于循环变换器（LT）的30亿参数智能体模型，该模型重复使用一层堆栈进行第二次前向传播，从而在不增加参数的情况下增加有效深度。在苹果硅芯片（MPS）上评估时，我们发现了五个独立错误，这些错误阻止了发布的检查点通过Hugging Face transformers直接运行（包括静默归零的RoPE缓冲区和调用已移除的transformers缓存API）。此外，我们表明，仅修复这些错误对于智能体任务仍不够，因为LT的层重用策略（有效将峰值注意力内存翻倍）用于实现参数效率。因此，我们引入了一种分块预填充策略，以缓解由此产生的内存容量惩罚，在32 GiB共享内存上将允许的上下文宽度扩展了2.7倍。然而，即使减少了内存开销，我们表明仍需补丁才能使Nanbeige4.2-3B可用。
tldr: 本文修复了Nanbeige4.2-3B在苹果硅芯片上的五个部署错误，并提出分块预填充策略，将内存开销降低，使上下文宽度扩展2.7倍，从而使其可用于智能体任务。
en_tdlr: This paper fixes five deployment bugs of Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon and proposes a chunked-prefill strategy that reduces memory overhead, extending context width by 2.7x, making it usable for agentic tasks.
